category_rule: Mean paired six-shift pixel AP difference over three seeds; > +0.1 pp improved, < -0.1 pp degraded, otherwise tied.
aggregation: Paired differences are formed within category, seed and condition. Categories and conditions receive equal weight within each seed. Mean and sample SD are then reported across the three seeds.
inference_limit: All categories were evaluated in earlier studies. These groups are not newly unseen validation sets. Seeds reuse the same test images and are not independent datasets; a positive mean or a category count is not a significance test.

training_manifest_checks.scope: Manifest-level final-step, parameter-count, split and paired-schedule checks. Raw checkpoint and metric recomputation belong to the execution audit.
